ikun-theme-skin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dff7c517d9856838f955.html
